# dart-ci.yml

<link-summary>Inputs, secrets and outputs of the reusable workflow Dart CI.</link-summary>

```text
Format, analyze, test and coverage of every Dart package of a repository: a single package, the
members of a pub workspace (nested or globbed) and packages outside the workspace. The same
workflow serves Flutter packages with `toolchain: flutter`; flutter-ci.yml calls it that way and
adds the Flutter specific inputs.

Every feature has an `<feature>-enabled` input and, where it runs a command, a `<feature>-command`
input that replaces it. Nothing here needs a secret; the optional ones sign in to a private
package host, private git dependencies and Codecov.
```

```yaml
jobs:
  dart-ci:
    uses: davils-com/workflows/.github/workflows/dart-ci.yml@v1
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `working-directory` | string | `.` | Directory of the root pubspec.yaml, relative to the repository root. |
| `discovery` | string | empty | Packages discovered before (pipeline.yml passes its own); empty discovers them here. |
| `include` | string | empty | Globs of package directories outside the workspace (newline or comma separated, or a JSON array). |
| `exclude` | string | empty | Globs of package directories to leave out. |
| `affected-only` | string | `auto` | true, false or auto (auto checks only the packages a pull request or merge group affects). |
| `base-sha` | string | empty | The commit to compare with for affected-only; empty takes it from the event. |
| `always-all-paths` | string | `["pubspec.yaml","pubspec.lock","analysis_options.yaml","dart_test.yaml","inspectra.yaml","inspectra.base.yaml","trivy*.yaml","tool/**",".github/**"]` | Globs relative to the working directory whose change affects every package. |
| `granularity` | string | `auto` | auto, package, workspace or shards; how packages spread over test jobs. |
| `shards` | number | `8` | Number of test jobs for granularity shards. |
| `shard-threshold` | number | `20` | Package count from which granularity auto shards. |
| `runners` | string | `{}` | JSON object of runner labels (linux, linux-arm, macos, windows, windows-arm); a JSON array value selects self-hosted runners. |
| `timeout-minutes` | number | `45` | Timeout of every job. |
| `harden-runner` | boolean | `true` | Run step-security/harden-runner first on Linux runners. |
| `harden-runner-egress-policy` | string | `audit` | audit or block. |
| `harden-runner-allowed-endpoints` | string | empty | Endpoints allowed with the block policy, space separated. |
| `pre-setup` | string | empty | Shell commands run in every job before any tool is set up. |
| `post-setup` | string | empty | Shell commands run in every job after the dependencies are resolved. |
| `pre-test` | string | empty | Shell commands run before the tests of every test job. |
| `post-test` | string | empty | Shell commands run after the tests of every test job, also when they failed. |
| `artifact-retention-days` | number | `7` | Days to keep the artifacts. |
| `fail-fast` | boolean | `false` | Cancel the other test jobs when one fails. |
| `pub-hosted-url` | string | empty | URL of a private package host; its token is the secret PUB_HOSTED_TOKEN. |
| `pub-get-args` | string | empty | Extra arguments for pub get, such as --enforce-lockfile. |
| `git-host` | string | `github.com` | Host of private git dependencies; its token is the secret GIT_DEPS_TOKEN. |
| `toolchain` | string | `dart` | dart or flutter. |
| `sdks` | string | `["stable","lowest"]` | JSON array of SDKs to test with (Flutter versions for flutter); stable, beta, lowest (the lower bound of the environment constraint) or a version. |
| `flutter-version-file` | string | empty | File to read the Flutter version from (pubspec.yaml or .fvmrc); wins over sdks. |
| `os` | string | `["ubuntu"]` | JSON array of operating systems (ubuntu, ubuntu-arm, macos, windows, windows-arm). |
| `extra-os-sdk` | string | `first` | first (other operating systems only test the first SDK) or all. |
| `format-enabled` | boolean | `true` | Check the formatting. |
| `format-command` | string | empty | Replaces dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed . |
| `analyze-enabled` | boolean | `true` | Run the analyzer. |
| `analyze-fatal-infos` | boolean | `true` | Fail on infos as well. |
| `analyze-command` | string | empty | Replaces the analyzer run (dart analyze or flutter analyze per package). |
| `build-runner-enabled` | string | `auto` | true, false or auto (packages with build_runner); checks that the generated files are committed. |
| `build-runner-command` | string | empty | Replaces dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs. |
| `verify-command` | string | empty | Extra checks run once in the format and analyze job, at the working directory, such as checks of generated files. |
| `l10n-enabled` | string | `auto` | true, false or auto (packages with l10n.yaml); checks that flutter gen-l10n output is committed. |
| `publish-dry-run-enabled` | string | `auto` | true, false or auto (publishable packages); runs pub publish --dry-run. |
| `test-enabled` | boolean | `true` | Run the tests. |
| `test-platforms` | string | empty | JSON array of dart test platforms (vm, chrome, firefox, node, chrome:dart2wasm); empty uses dart_test.yaml. |
| `test-platforms-other-os` | string | empty | JSON array of dart test platforms for every operating system but the first of os; empty uses test-platforms. |
| `test-command` | string | empty | Replaces the test command; runs in every package directory with PACKAGE_NAME and PACKAGE_PATH set. |
| `test-args` | string | empty | Extra arguments for dart test or flutter test. |
| `test-exclude-tags` | string | empty | Tags to skip. |
| `test-report-enabled` | boolean | `false` | Upload JSON test reports (artifacts davils-test-reports-*); test-report.yml turns them into a check run. |
| `golden-enabled` | boolean | `false` | Flutter only. Run the golden tests (tag golden-tags) on golden-os, where the goldens were recorded. |
| `golden-os` | string | `macos` | Operating system of the golden tests. |
| `golden-tags` | string | `golden` | Tag of the golden tests; the regular test jobs skip it when golden-enabled. |
| `integration-test-enabled` | boolean | `false` | Flutter only. Run integration_test/ on a desktop device. |
| `integration-test-device` | string | `auto` | auto (linux with a virtual display), linux, macos or windows; Flutter runs integration tests on desktop devices only. |
| `coverage-enabled` | boolean | `true` | Collect coverage in the first test job of every package. |
| `coverage-source` | string | `auto` | auto (leave packages whose Inspectra coverage gate is on to Inspectra), ci (always here), inspectra or none. |
| `inspectra-enabled` | boolean | `false` | true when the inspectra workflow runs in the same pipeline (for coverage-source auto). |
| `coverage-aggregate` | boolean | `true` | Merge the coverage of the test jobs in a coverage job here (minimum, Codecov, Pages part); pipeline.yml merges it itself, together with Inspectra's. |
| `coverage-min` | number | `0` | Minimum total line coverage in percent; 0 disables the check. |
| `codecov-enabled` | boolean | `false` | Upload the coverage to Codecov; private repositories need the secret CODECOV_TOKEN. |
| `pages-part-enabled` | boolean | `false` | Upload the HTML coverage report as a part of the GitHub Pages site (pages.yml). |
| `pana-enabled` | boolean | `false` | Dart only. Score the publishable packages with pana. |
| `pana-min-points` | number | `0` | Minimum pana points; 0 only reports. |
| `downgrade-enabled` | boolean | `false` | Resolve the lowest allowed dependency versions and analyze and test against them. |

## Secrets

All secrets are optional.

- `PUB_HOSTED_TOKEN`
- `GIT_DEPS_TOKEN`
- `CODECOV_TOKEN`

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `coverage` | The total line coverage in percent. |
| `discovery` | The discovered packages. |

## Permissions the caller grants

- `contents: read`
